Package httyd.model.dragon

Class DragonSpecies

java.lang.Object
httyd.model.dragon.DragonSpecies
public final class DragonSpecies extends Object
Immutable template of a dragon species: base stats, class, moves and passive. Every owned dragon is a rolled variation of one species.
